name: lutino
description: Configurable plugin that identifies the current user to your backend via MCP headers and optional session presence pings

backend_url.title: Backend base URL
backend_url.description: Base URL of your backend, without trailing slash (the MCP endpoint is <url>/mcp)

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: Your user id in the backend

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Personal access token issued by the backend (sent as a Bearer token)

presence.title: Send presence pings
presence.description: Notify the backend when a Claude Code session starts and ends
